headline: Ghanshyambhai Mohanbhai Kumbhani files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Ghanshyambhai Mohanbhai Kumbhani has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE following a substantial acquisition of shares in Sikko Industries Limited. The filing triggers mandatory open offer obligations under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Ghanshyambhai Mohanbhai Kumbhani submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, signalling a material increase in shareholding in Sikko Industries Limited. The filing is a mandatory pre-offer disclosure required within 4 trading days of crossing the substantial acquisition threshold. This triggers the requirement for an open offer at a floor price determined by SEBI methodology within 60 calendar days. The acquirer's identity and exact shareholding % are disclosed in the filed document; the transaction structure and consideration remain subject to the subsequent open offer announcement.
